title_block.title: Test Model 5
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Complex Test Case 5 - View 1 (of 2). Includes Atomic Test Cases - 11, 18, 19, 23, 24, 37, 42, 44; PMI Complex Test Case 5 - View 2 (of 2). Includes Atomic Test Cases - 25, 38, 42

features.label: whole part
features.description: The part as a whole. General notes apply to all of it.

features.label: outer rim of the flange
features.description: The outer cylindrical surface of the large round flange.

features.label: round boss on the flange front face
features.description: Large round raised boss on the front face of the flange, around the hub block and shaft (view 1).

features.label: rectangular block between shaft and flange
features.description: Block with flat sides standing on the flange front face, between the flange and the shaft (view 1).

features.label: side face of the notch at the right of the flange
features.description: Flat side face of the rectangular notch cut into the right edge of the flange in view 1. The hatched rectangle on it is datum target area C1.

features.label: shaft
features.description: The long round shaft sticking out of the hub block (view 1). Its surface carries datum feature A.

features.label: back face of the flange
features.description: The flat back face of the large flange, seen in view 2.

features.label: large bore in the flange back face
features.description: Large round bore in the back face of the flange, seen in view 2. Its axis is datum feature B.

values.meaning: Circular runout: as the part turns about the common axis of datums A and B, each circular section of the flange rim may vary by at most .025 in.
Concentricity: the median points of the round boss must lie in a .030 in diameter cylinder centred on the datum A axis.

values.applies_to: length of the block along the shaft axis
values.meaning: The block length must be 5.000 in plus or minus .008 in, so between 4.992 and 5.008 in; the <ST> symbol marks it as a statistical tolerance.

values.applies_to: the line element drawn on the block's top face (supplemental geometry)
values.meaning: Straightness: the marked line element on the block's top face must lie between two parallel lines .005 in apart; no datum is used.

values.applies_to: length of the hatched datum target area C1
values.meaning: Basic dimension (boxed): the rectangular datum target area C1 is exactly 2.000 in long.
Datum feature A: the shaft's cylindrical surface; its axis is datum A.

values.raw: Datum feature B and Datum target D1 defined in View 2 (of 2).
values.meaning: Sheet note: datum feature B and datum target D1 are shown on the second view.
Total runout: as the part turns about the datum B axis, the whole back face of the flange must stay within .015 in of a plane square to that axis.
The bore diameter must be 10.000 in plus or minus .001 in, so between 9.999 and 10.001 in. Datum feature symbol B hangs on this dimension.
Sheet note naming the test case and view: complex test case 5, second of two views.
